title.en: Muscle tissue, neural tissue and organ systems
title.kn: ಸ್ನಾಯು ಅಂಗಾಂಶ, ನರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗವ್ಯೂಹಗಳು

heading.en: Tissues that move and tissues that signal

hook.en: You decide to lift your arm, and it moves. Your heart beats a hundred thousand times a day without your asking. Your stomach churns food on its own. Three kinds of muscle are at work.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಲು ಬಯಸಿದರೆ ಅದು ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೃದಯ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಲಕ್ಷ ಬಾರಿ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಬಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಜಠರ ತಾನೇ ಆಹಾರ ಕಲಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಬಗೆಯ ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳಿವೆ.

objectives.en: Compare skeletal, smooth and cardiac muscle
Explain the organisation of tissues into organs and organ systems

narration.en: You decide to lift your arm, and it moves. Your heart beats a hundred thousand times a day without your asking. Your stomach churns food on its own. Three kinds of muscle are at work.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಲು ಬಯಸಿದರೆ ಅದು ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೃದಯ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಲಕ್ಷ ಬಾರಿ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಬಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಜಠರ ತಾನೇ ಆಹಾರ ಕಲಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಬಗೆಯ ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: Muscle tissue is made of long, cylindrical fibres arranged in parallel, each made of fine myofibrils; the fibres contract in response to stimulation and then relax. Skeletal muscle is attached to bones and is striated, with bundles wrapped in tough connective tissue, as in the biceps. Smooth muscle fibres taper at both ends, are not striated, and are found in the walls of blood vessels, the stomach and the intestine; they are involuntary. Cardiac muscle is found only in the heart; cell junctions fuse the plasma membranes of its cells so that they contract as a unit.
body.kn: ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳದ್ದು, ಮೂಳೆಗೆ ಅಂಟಿದೆ (ಬೈಸೆಪ್ಸ್). ನಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆರಹಿತ, ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ; ರಕ್ತನಾಳ, ಜಠರ, ಕರುಳಿನ ಗೋಡೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ. ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಕೋಶ ಸಂಧಿಗಳಿಂದ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಸಂಕುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Smooth: fusiform, non-striated, involuntary; gut and vessels
Cardiac: only in heart, contracts as a unit

title.en: On the board: Muscle tissue, neural tissue and organ systems

say.en: Skeletal muscle is long, striped and voluntary, like the biceps.
Smooth muscle fibres taper at both ends, have no stripes and are involuntary.
Cardiac muscle is found only in the heart; its cells are joined so they contract as one.
Tissues build organs, and organs work together as organ systems.
In neural tissue, neuroglia make up more than half the volume.

text.en: Neuroglia: over half of neural tissue

body.en: Neural tissue exerts the greatest control over the body's responsiveness to changing conditions. Neurons are the excitable cells: when suitably stimulated, an electrical disturbance travels swiftly along the plasma membrane. Neuroglial cells protect and support the neurons and make up more than half the volume of neural tissue in our body.
body.kn: ನರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ದೇಹದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನರಕೋಶಗಳು ಉದ್ರೇಕಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕೋಶಗಳು. ನ್ಯೂರೋಗ್ಲಿಯಾ ಕೋಶಗಳು ನರಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ; ನರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶದ ಅರ್ಧಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಗಾತ್ರ.

body.en: Tissues are organised in specific proportions and patterns to form organs such as the stomach, lung, heart and kidney. Two or more organs working together by physical and chemical interaction form an organ system, such as the digestive or respiratory system. Cells, tissues, organs and organ systems divide the work of the body and help it survive.
body.kn: ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿ ಅಂಗಗಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ಎರಡು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಗಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಅಂಗವ್ಯೂಹವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: Turn the neuron: the dendrites receive signals, the cell body holds the nucleus, and the long axon carries the impulse to its terminals. Around neurons in real tissue are neuroglial cells, which support and protect them.

problem.en: A tissue sample has spindle-shaped fibres tapering at both ends, without stripes, held together by cell junctions. Where in the body could it come from, and is it under voluntary control?

steps.en: Fibres tapering at both ends without striations are smooth muscle.
Smooth muscle lines the walls of internal organs like blood vessels, the stomach and the intestine.
It is involuntary: we cannot directly control it.

answer.en: Smooth muscle from the wall of the stomach, intestine or a blood vessel; involuntary
